svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two the same. Saw 60 mm off 40 x 40 mm bar; file square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore: drill 20.5 mm right through the 40 x 40 faces, on centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stud hole: on one 40 x 60 side face, at mid-height (30 mm up)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and centred, drill 5.0 mm 12 deep and tap M6 10 deep.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Set screw hole: on the opposite side face, 45 mm up and centred,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drill 6.8 mm through into the bore and tap M8.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: slides onto the pin; the stud face points at the other pin

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: across the crack. Set the block centre 110 mm above ground and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tighten the M8 set screw onto the pin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Screw the M6 stud of a rod-end ball joint 10 mm into the stud hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the block slides on a 20 mm bar with no shake beyond 0.5 mm.
